title: ASPIRE transfer pays out more than the revenue
why: Row 2629 = (1 + scale) x benefit x [decile targeted] - benefit x [decile targeted] = scale x benefit for every person of a decile with any targeted share (Q2562 <> 0). The scale P2626 = funds / P2624 is computed over the actual receivers (row 2621 = share receiving x population). So a partly targeted decile gets the full benefit for all its members, leakage receivers in untargeted deciles get nothing, and the payout is not the funds: 125-129% for Egypt.
ref: P2624 = SUM(row 2622) = sum of receivers (2621) x annual benefit (2619); row 2568 = % of the decile receiving.
effect: ASPIRE path only (TransferType not Cash); none for Egypt by default. The payout, sum of row 2629 x row 2572, now equals the funds P2625. prototype v0.6.0.
note: Row 2628 (display only) keeps the old basis; nothing reads it after the fix.

why: G659:BR659 = INDEX($I$471:$I$486, MATCH(code, $B$470:$B$486, 0)): the INDEX range starts one row below the MATCH range, so every sector takes the coefficient of the next row of the table (avi gets nav's, power gets rail's 0.905); power's own row (470) has no coefficient.

fixes.fill: single cell (new constant: power passes costs through fully)

ref: Pass-through table B470:I486 (code, sector, coefficient I).
effect: Only with PassthroughDist = Yes (Egypt default No): each sector gets its own coefficient; power 1. prototype v0.6.0.
